√har 'be gratified'
present: [4.] háryati háryate etc. 
[perfect: jaharya ajaharyat aharyīt haryiṣyati haryitā jāharya- jiharyiṣa- haryaya- ]
derivatives: haryatá 
Perhaps a derivative from √hṛ.
A conspicuous group of words show an inferable root har or hir 'be yellow': thus,hári V.+ harít V.+ hárita V.+ hariṇá V.+ harimán V. híraṇya V.+ híri- RV.
